title: Enterprise Island Rollouts: Roadmap Heatmap and OKR Slices
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Create a prioritized, deliverable roadmap for 'island' (isolated) enterprise deployments that maps features, risk, and OKR outcomes across the next two quarters. This ticket will produce a stakeholder-aligned heatmap, a sequenced milestone plan for waves, and an OKR slice that ties each milestone to measurable outcomes (latency SLOs, customer onboarding time, upgrade run rate, and cost delta).

Scope: features and workstreams relevant to Private/VPC/on-prem customers only — Dedicated onboarding flows, private control-plane ops, KMS integrations, network topology templates, upgrade windows and compatibility gates, and rollout automation for multi-tenant isolation. Excludes Hosted API product changes and generic console visual polish unless they directly affect private deployments.

Deliverables:
- A 2-quarter milestone map with wave definitions and acceptance criteria for each wave.
- A visual heatmap showing technical risk (upgrade complexity, compatibility, data migration) and business risk (customer impact, regulatory constraints) per milestone.
- OKR mapping: 3 measurable objectives with key results tied to release gates.
- Communication/playbook templates for customer success and solutions engineering for each wave.

Success criteria: cross-functional sign-off from Eng, Security, Sales, CS; a validated wave sequencing that reduces upgrade blast radius; at least two customers committed to the first wave pilot before GA planning begins.
acceptance_criteria: Heatmap artifact created with risk scores and mitigation notes for every milestone
Milestone map with dates, owners, and rollback criteria for each wave
OKR slice defined with quantifiable KRs (numbers or percentages) and targets
Stakeholder sign-off recorded (Eng, Security, CS, Sales, Legal)
Pilot commitment from at least two enterprise customers for Wave 1
milestones: Wave 0: Internal validation - runtime compatibility tests and upgrade simulation (owner: ENG-compat)
Wave 1: Pilot rollouts to two enterprise customers - private control plane + KMS + network templates
Wave 2: Broader early access - automation for upgrade windows, RBAC mapping, audit logs export
Wave 3: GA readiness - SLA docs, billing integration, scale testing and runbook publication
risks: Upgrade incompatibilities between quantized model variants and customer's GPU fleet
Complex network topologies causing longer-than-expected onboarding times
KMS/HSM certification gaps in target regions delaying pilots
Insufficient observability hooks for per-tenant cost attribution
Rollout automation edge cases causing inability to rollback cleanly
